title: LGBTQ+ Affirming Therapy in California
label: LGBTQ+ affirming care
description: LGBTQ+ affirming online therapy for California adults and couples with Rachel Boyer, LMFT. Support for identity, relationships, anxiety, and life transitions.
heading: Space for your identity, your relationships, and your whole life.
body:
You deserve therapy where your identity is respected and your experiences are met with curiosity and care. I offer LGBTQ+ affirming online therapy for adults and couples throughout California, including transgender and gender-diverse clients. Our work begins with what matters to you.

## You choose the focus

You may want to explore identity, coming out, family relationships, dating, or changes in how you understand yourself. You may also be seeking support for anxiety, depression, grief, work stress, or relationship difficulties. Your identity does not have to be the subject of every session.

We make room for the effects of rejection, discrimination, and the effort of navigating environments where you may not feel fully seen. We also attend to your strengths, sources of belonging, and the people and practices that support you.

## An affirming, collaborative relationship

I respect your name, pronouns, and how you describe your experience. You set the pace for what you share, and you can tell me when something does not feel right. We explore goals together rather than making assumptions about the life or relationships you want.

I draw on ACT, mindfulness, compassion, and trauma-informed care. Our work may involve responding to self-critical thoughts, clarifying values, practicing boundaries, or finding ways to stay connected to yourself during difficult interactions.

## Online care throughout California

Individual sessions and couples therapy take place by secure video while clients are physically in California. Individual therapy may be available through eligible insurance plans using Headway, or you can contact me about private pay. Couples inquiries come directly to me.

Read more about [my approach](/act-therapy-california), [relationship therapy](/couples-therapy-california), and [what to expect when we meet](/#expect).
